From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FluxCloud vendor docs & PO readiness — payment ops follow-up

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to get FluxCloud onboarded for the pilot. To get finance to create a PO and enable payments we need the following from you: 

- Completed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if non-US). Please confirm which applies.
- Legal business name as it should appear on the PO and invoice
- EIN / Tax ID (or VAT registration number if EU/UK)
- Remittance instructions: bank name, account number (ACH/IBAN), routing/Swift code — please attach a redacted bank stub if possible.
- Confirm preferred invoice email (for automated ingestion) and billing contact.
- A sample invoice (PDF) showing your invoice number format and line itemization.

We have a short supplier questionnaire attached to capture additional fields — you can return the questionnaire plus the above documents. Once we have those we can:

1) Create a vendor record and issue a PO (target within 3 business days)
2) Share the PO number and supplier portal access for invoice submission

If you prefer, you can upload everything directly to our supplier portal: https://redwood.example.com/supplier-portal/fluxcloud (link below).

Thanks — copying Monica from Finance to speed review.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
(415) 555-2198

Hi Lauren / Monica,

Thanks — attaching what we have on file. Quick notes: FluxCloud is a US-registered C-Corp (EIN included on the W-9). I attached:

- FluxCloud_W-9_signed.pdf (signed W-9 with EIN)
- FluxCloud_BANK_INSTRUCTIONS.pdf (bank remittance details, redacted copy of voided check)
- FluxCloud_Supplier_Questionnaire.docx (completed)
- Sample_Invoice_FluxCloud_001.pdf (sample invoice)

We do not have a VAT number; we are US-only for now. Let me know if the W-9 file needs to be a different format or if any fields are missing.

Also: can you confirm the PO contact and whether Redwood requires a supplier setup form with vendor terms? Happy to sign any standard onboarding agreement (DocuSign is easiest).

Thanks,

Subject: Re: FluxCloud vendor docs & PO readiness — payment ops follow-up

Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. A couple of items Finance spotted while reviewing: 

- The W-9 we received is signed but the EIN line is truncated in the scan — can you resend a clearer copy or confirm the EIN number in the body of the email?
- In the supplier questionnaire we ask for an exact remit-to email for invoice ingestion (example: invoices+fluxcloud@redwood.ai). Can you confirm which email you want used for PO acknowledgements and automated invoice delivery?
- Do you have a preferred PO acknowledgement workflow? We can either: 1) send the PO and expect a formal signed acknowledgement, or 2) use automated acceptance in our portal (faster). Please indicate preference.

Markus — can you confirm whether we need additional tax W-9 fields for AR automation (we're mapping to our vendor profile fields)?

Sofia — if you can resend the W-9 (PDF or high-res image) and confirm the two bullets above, we'll proceed to create the vendor and raise a PO. Target: PO issued within 48 hours of receipt of clarified docs.

Best,
Lauren

Responding to your bullets:

- Remit-to email for invoices: invoices@fluxcloud.io (please send PO and invoice acknowledgements to this address)

Next steps request from our side: can you confirm the expected first payment date once PO is issued, and whether Redwood's net terms are NET30 or NET45 for pilot partners? That helps us forecast cash flow.
